title: Finite-degree equations for a closed subspace of relative Proj
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact (it admits a surjective etale atlas from a quasi-compact scheme) and quasi-separated (its absolute diagonal is quasi-compact on scheme tests). Let $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal A_n$ be a commutative unital graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra on the small etale site [def-trf-etale-graded-module-algebra], with each $\mathcal A_n$ quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Write $\pi:P=P_X(\mathcal A)\to X$ for its relative Proj [lem-sfb-space-relative-proj-scheme-tests], and assume $\pi$ is quasi-compact [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow P$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of finite presentation, meaning locally of finite presentation on etale scheme charts [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Then there exist an integer $d>0$ and a finite-type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-submodule $\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal A_d$ such that the closed immersion $P_X(\mathcal A/(\mathcal F\mathcal A))\hookrightarrow P$ induced by the quotient map $\mathcal A\to\mathcal A/(\mathcal F\mathcal A)$ [lem-sfb-space-relative-proj-quotient-closed-immersion] identifies $$P_X(\mathcal A/(\mathcal F\mathcal A))=Z$$ as closed subspaces of $P$. Here finite type means etale locally finitely generated; $\mathcal F\mathcal A$ is the homogeneous sheaf of ideals generated by $\mathcal F$ placed in degree $d$, with quotient computed in quasi-coherent algebra sheaves [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus]. No Noetherian hypothesis, generation in degree one, or finite-type hypothesis on the components $\mathcal A_n$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 085M, lemma-closed-subscheme-proj-finite (statement and proof). The source calls Z a closed subscheme of P; it means a closed subspace, as in the preceding Tag 085L and the etale-local proof.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-proj-homogeneous-ideal-recovery] to choose a quasi-coherent homogeneous ideal $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal A$ with $P_X(\mathcal A/\mathcal I)=Z$ as closed subspaces. Apply [lem-trf-space-qc-finite-affine-atlas-refinement] to an atlas of the quasi-compact space $X$, obtaining a representable surjective etale map $u:U=\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$. Its hypothesis uses exactly the definition of quasi-compactness assumed here.

On $U$, [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus] identifies the restricted graded algebra and ideal with $A=\bigoplus_n\mathcal A_n(U)$ and $I=\bigoplus_n\mathcal I_n(U)$; quotients are computed degreewise. By [lem-sfb-space-relative-proj-scheme-tests], $P_U=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ and $Z_U=\operatorname{Proj}(A/I)$, and by the affine-chart clause of [lem-sfb-space-relative-proj-quotient-closed-immersion] the base change of $Z=P_X(\mathcal A/\mathcal I)\hookrightarrow P$ is the quotient-induced inclusion $\operatorname{Proj}(A/I)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Proj}(A)$. The quasi-compactness of $\pi$ makes $P_U$ quasi-compact by [lem-sfb-space-quasicompact-affine-tests]. By [lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality], $Z_U\hookrightarrow P_U$ is of finite presentation. Apply [lem-sfb-affine-proj-ideal-single-degree] to this prescribed $I$: obtain $d>0$ and finitely many $g_j\in I_d$ whose $R$-span $F\subseteq I_d$ satisfies $\operatorname{Proj}(A/FA)=Z_U$.

Apply [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-finite-type-union] to $M=\mathcal I_d$ on the qcqs space $X$. Evaluation on the affine etale chart $U$ computes this small filtered colimit by [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus]. Thus each of the finitely many $g_j\in M(U)$ belongs to $N_j(U)$ for some finite-type quasi-coherent submodule $N_j\subseteq M$. Directedness gives one such submodule $\mathcal F$ containing all the $N_j$ (take zero if the list is empty). Hence $F\subseteq\mathcal F(U)\subseteq I_d$. Since $\mathcal I_d\subseteq\mathcal A_d$ is a submodule, this is also the required finite-type submodule of $\mathcal A_d$.

Put $\mathcal J=\mathcal F\mathcal A\subseteq\mathcal I$ and $Z^{\prime}=P_X(\mathcal A/\mathcal J)$. The generated ideal and quotient are quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-relative-proj-quotient-closed-immersion] to obtain $Z^{\prime}\hookrightarrow P$. On $U$, the ideals satisfy $FA\subseteq\mathcal J(U)\subseteq I$. Quotient surjections and the composition clause of the same Proj lemma therefore give closed-subscheme inclusions $$Z_U\subseteq Z^{\prime}_U\subseteq\operatorname{Proj}(A/FA)=Z_U.$$ Both composites into $P_U$ are the original quotient-induced inclusions. Thus $Z^{\prime}_U=Z_U$ as closed subschemes, including their nilpotent structure.

By [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], $P_U\to P$ is a surjective etale cover. Apply [lem-sfb-space-ideal-closed-subspace-correspondence] to $Z$ and $Z^{\prime}$ in $P$. Their quasi-coherent defining ideals restrict to the defining ideals of $Z_U$ and $Z^{\prime}_U$, respectively, so these restrictions agree by Step 4. Membership in a subsheaf can be checked on a cover; hence the two ideals on $P$ agree. The same bijection gives $Z^{\prime}=Z$ as closed subspaces. The integer $d>0$ and submodule $\mathcal F$ from Step 3 prove the assertion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_spaceProj_finite_degree_equations {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (hqc : ∃ (U : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj), CompactSpace U.left ∧ IsEtale a ∧ IsSurjective a) (hqs : ∀ (U V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X.obj.obj), IsAffine U.left → IsAffine V.left → CompactSpace (Point (Limits.pullback a b))) (C : SpaceProjCoefficients S) (R : SpaceProjSystem C) (Q : SpaceProjQuotientSystem C R) (A : SpaceProjInput X) (hπ : MapIsQuasiCompact (R.realization A).projection.hom.hom) (Z : AlgebraicSpace S) (i : Z ⟶ (R.realization A).space) (hi : IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsClosedImmersion p.left) i.hom.hom) (hifp : MapIsLocallyOfFinitePresentation i) (hiqc : MapIsQuasiCompact i.hom.hom) (hiqs : MapIsQuasiCompact (Limits.pullback.diagonal i.hom.hom)) : ∃ (d : ℕ), 0 < d ∧ ∃ (F : X.Modules) (j : F ⟶ A.piece d), Mono j ∧ F.IsQuasicoherent ∧ F.IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (B : SpaceProjInput X) (φ : EtaleGradedModuleAlgebra.Hom A.algebra B.algebra) (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, Epi (φ.degree n)), j ≫ φ.degree d = 0 ∧ (∀ (D : ℕ → X.Modules) (Dalg : EtaleGradedModuleAlgebra D) (ψ : EtaleGradedModuleAlgebra.Hom A.algebra Dalg), j ≫ ψ.degree d = 0 → ∃! χ : EtaleGradedModuleAlgebra.Hom B.algebra Dalg, ∀ n : ℕ, φ.degree n ≫ χ.degree n = ψ.degree n) ∧ ∃ e : (R.realization B).space ≅ Z, e.hom ≫ i = Q.map φ hφ
